global_constraints: Public repository uses synthetic fixtures only; real snapshots require an approved private SourceRelease.
Use confirmed data and explicit missing/availability states.
Keep default khwaeng/LAO profile and frozen nationwide benchmark.
Do not modify unrelated modules or previous deliverables.
Acceptance commands are scaffolded by task 00 before later work.
Return changed files, test results and unresolved evidence gates.

tasks.coding_prompt: Scaffold the agreed modular repository and local DB. Create the commands declared in the implementation plan, TH/EN key structure, and LDS asset wrappers. Do not invent a production backend from the existing static demo.

inputs: Approved private SourceRelease supplied by data owner for production
outputs: Source catalog and approved import gate
tasks.coding_prompt: Build the approved private import gate using synthetic fixtures in public CI. A production source needs owner permission, stable IDs, exact nine fuel metrics, source periods, coverage, checksums and separate missing states. Never copy real rows or POI coordinates into this public repository.

inputs: source boundary/crosswalk releases supplied by data owner
tasks.coding_prompt: Resolve Bangkok khwaeng and upcountry LAO tiers through a verified allowlist, excluding PAOs and overlaps. Do not treat prototype province geometry or source bounding extents as current municipality polygons. Block missing boundary evidence explicitly.

inputs: Approved private run when connecting production data
tasks.coding_prompt: Build a read-only map/list/detail vertical slice. The public demo uses synthetic data; production reads a separately approved run. Render aggregate B/C/U, brand coverage only when sourced, raw Demand profiles and eight-pattern reasons with source versions. Counts are not sales share; point maps require approved real coordinates.

inputs: Approved private POI source records, or synthetic fixtures for public tests
tasks.coding_prompt: Implement tenant-scoped Supply CRUD with evidence, revisions, no-op detection and idempotency. Commit one event per real operation. Source POI edits do not mutate the pinned aggregate baseline.

inputs: Approved private source records and aggregate vintage metadata
tasks.coding_prompt: Reconcile POI identity, cross-layer duplicates, boundary membership, operation status and source dates. Matching totals alone do not establish same vintage. Publish new analytical counts only after successful reconciliation; preserve old runs.

Implement the fixed Bangchak baseline: building P99/P95/any and activity P95 hits 5/3/1 with tri-state missing. Keep B>=3/C>=3. Make extra signals opt-in and reject unavailable metrics. Explain any ranking separately from source classification.

Apply criteria with base revision checks for Admin/Editor only. Publish immutable run pointers atomically; preserve latest good results on failure. Draft previews do not write team events and every view must disclose the run it displays.

Build shared targets and context feeds that reuse one event ID across criteria/place/supply/team. Notify other authorized active members once. Revoke access at read time, not only when a notification is created.

Count committed human operations only, defaulting to a 30-day period. Exclude views, clicks, sample seed events, no-ops, failed writes and retries. Count bulk commits once and affected records separately. Do not create employee performance scores.

Expand the metric catalog through verified adapters. Factory count is already core. School size uses verified source classification or explicit thresholds with size data; hospital beds cannot be inferred from POI types. Disabled options show what is missing.

Complete manual sharing with permission checks and browser verification across TH/EN and responsive sizes. Record unperformed browser checks as pending; do not fabricate screenshots. Public preview data remains synthetic.
